work.title: Alkahest Reference Book
work.subtitle: A feature specimen for a universal technical-book template

descriptions.short: A working specimen for testing a reusable, multi-format technical-book publishing system.
descriptions.long: Alkahest Reference Book exercises the structure, typography, technical content, accessibility, rights, and reproducibility contracts needed by a reusable template for print, web, and EPUB publication. It is development evidence rather than a released book.

rights.statement: Rights and publication licenses remain intentionally undecided while this reference specimen is in development.

accessibility.summary: Automated EPUBCheck and Ace by DAISY checks are part of this publication workflow. Manual EPUB Accessibility 1.1 review is pending, so this reference specimen makes no accessibility conformance claim.

provenance.source_statement: Canonical manuscripts are maintained as neutral Quarto Markdown with backend-specific layout code kept in template adapters.
provenance.reproducibility_statement: The locked rootless toolchain, fixed build inputs, and exact artifact fingerprints define the reproducible-build contract.
